crossRefs.note: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth.
My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters…
transgressing and denying Yahweh, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving…
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
Friends deceive each other, and will not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies. They weary…
And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets…
Yahweh God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”
In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the…
Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
“Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
“Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”

translations.web: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips.
translations.bsb: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
translations.kjv: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
